create_Variable_with_value_and_distribut: create a Variable with a torch tensor value and a torch distribution for probabilistic inference
create_Variable_with_parents_and_childre: create a Variable with parent and child RVIdentifiers to track the dependency graph during inference
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a Variable value given its distribution using the log_prob property
replace_Variable_fields: replace specific fields of a Variable to produce an updated copy with new parents or children
summarize_Variable_class: summarize the Variable dataclass used for maintaining metadata of random variables during inference
